difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a sheaf is a subobject of the final object if and only if the slice topos over it is a subtopos of the ambient topos (statement lines 10330-10340). The proof is a complete argument: the companion results reduce the situation to a good site with a representable sheaf (proof lines 10343-10353); the subtopos condition is turned into the statement that a certain composite is the identity, which evaluated on representables and interpreted through Yoneda gives that the structure morphism is a monomorphism (proof lines 10356-10371); and conversely the monomorphism property gives the composite identity by the companion computation (proof lines 10373-10375). The non-formal content is the evaluation on representables and the Yoneda argument. The claim is H2: both directions written out with each input named.
